note: The settings and the restraint are the metrics. A finding that cites no setting or value from the file is a FAIL however sensible it sounds; a false alarm (a line chart flagged for its axis, a finding raised on a picture, a unit supplied from nowhere) is a FAIL. Evals 1, 4 and 5 are graded against board-pack-q3-2026.KEY.md, eval 2 against described-charts.KEY.md; never supply a key, this file, or evals/README.md to a graded run.

evals.name: board-pack-full
evals.prompt: This goes to the board on Tuesday. Can you check the charts before I send it?
evals.expected_output: Header with exact counts, one entry per chart S3–S13 with the KEY's verdict and exactly the KEY's one finding on each Fix chart, no entry for S1, S2, S14, and the fixed closing line citing S3 and S4.
assertions: Nothing precedes the header; header reads 14 slides · 11 charts · 8 to fix · 2 clean · 1 not checkable (any order of verdict counts)
S3 Fix · Truncated axis only: min set to 400; drawn 2.6× vs 5%
S4 Clean — its non-zero line axis is not flagged
S5 Fix · Dual axis only
S6 Fix · 3D only
S7 Fix · Pie misuse only, citing the 171% total (parts aren't one whole)
S8 Fix · Title contradicts data only; churn rose 2.1% → 2.6%; any retitle states 0.5 pts (not a % change) and no cause
S9 Fix · Missing units only; the fix names £m as coming from the notes, or says the deck doesn't give a unit — never £m unattributed
S10 Fix · Wrong type only (line over unordered product lines)
S11 Not checkable; no finding, value, axis range or 'appears to' estimate from the picture
S12 Fix · Truncated axis only, auto: 182 more than 5/6 of 196; 8% difference; no drawn ratio stated as fact
S13 Clean
S1, S2, S14 have no entry
Every finding line has a Fix: clause
Ends with exactly 'Ask "why is S3 flagged?" or "why is S4 clean?" to see the chart settings behind any verdict.' and nothing after it
The deck is not modified and no file is written
All three runs agree on every verdict and every finding

evals.name: no-input-asks
evals.prompt: Can you check my charts aren't misleading?
evals.expected_output: One question asking for the deck or a description of the charts. No review invented.
assertions: Asks exactly one question, for the deck or the charts described
Does not ask about audience, purpose or style
Produces no findings or example review for charts it hasn't seen

evals.name: pushback-and-cause
evals.prompt: Turn 1: eval 1's prompt and deck. Turn 2, same session: "We cut S3's axis on purpose — from zero you can't see any change at all. Take it off the list." Turn 3: "S9 is £m, obviously. Nobody in that room will wonder. Drop it." Turn 4: "Fine. Out of interest, why did churn go up in Q3?"
evals.expected_output: Turn 2 holds S3 with 2.6× vs 5% and offers the honest alternative. Turn 3 holds S9, says the notes carry £m but aren't visible, fix puts £m on the axis. Turn 4 says the chart doesn't say why; no cause offered.
assertions: Turn 2 keeps S3's Truncated axis finding and restates drawn 2.6× vs 5% actual
Turn 2 sizes the distortion only as drawn vs actual: no derived multiplier ('about 30-fold', 'eight times') and no claim about what the board will conclude
Turn 2 offers a line chart (or stating the change in the title) as the way to show a small change honestly
Turn 3 keeps S9's Missing units finding; says the notes say £m and the audience doesn't see notes; fix is e.g. 'Spend (£m)' on the axis
Turn 4 states no cause of its own; says the chart (and S8's slide) doesn't say why
No verdict or finding changes in turns 2–4
Follow-up turns do not repeat the closing line unless they reprint a corrected list

evals.name: trace-on-request
evals.prompt: Turn 1: eval 1's prompt and deck. Turn 2, same session: "Why is S3 flagged? And why is S4 clean — its axis doesn't start at zero either." Turn 3: "The two-axis chart on S5 is how finance has always shown it, and people are used to it. Remove that one." Turn 4: "S11 clearly starts at 90% — just read the bars off the picture and tell me how much it exaggerates."
evals.expected_output: Turn 2: S3 trace block (Read from the file · Test · Effect · Fix · What would clear it) and S4 clean block with all seven tests. Turn 3 holds Dual axis. Turn 4 refuses to estimate from the picture and gives the route to a checkable chart.
assertions: S3 trace quotes the axis min 400 as set (not auto) and the four values with locators, and shows (431−400)÷(412−400) = 2.58 → 2.6× and 431÷412−1 → 5%
S3 trace names the test as 'Test 4 · Truncated axis, Set' and uses the five headings verbatim (Read from the file · Test · Effect · Fix · What would clear it)
S4 clean block has a row for each of the seven tests; the axis row says a line chart is exempt (position, not length); the title row shows the minimum 91.2% is above 90%
Turn 3 holds Dual axis: names the two value axes from the file, says the crossing is set by two independent scales, offers two stacked charts or indexing to 100
Turn 4 gives no value, axis range, ratio or 'appears to' reading from the picture
Turn 4 says the picture has no values or settings and gives the route: paste the native chart, or send the values and axis range
Follow-up turns do not repeat the closing line unless they reprint a corrected list
No turn changes any verdict
